core_obligations: Introduce the auxiliary matrix defined by the difference of the two first order recurrence matrices through its expansion at infinity and write its jump in terms of the two solutions (proof lines 923-931).
Show that the boundary values of the auxiliary matrix are integrable, using the model solution of the companion problem and the relations between the two solutions (proof lines 931-982).

Represent the auxiliary matrix by the Sokhotski-Plemelj formula from its jump and use the particular form of the jump matrices to rewrite the integrand as the product of the difference of the two jump matrices with the inverse of one of the solutions (proof lines 983-990).
Compare the resulting expansion at infinity with the defining expansion to read off the stated integral formula (proof lines 990-992).
proof_roadmap: Auxiliary matrix and its jump (proof lines 923-931).
Integrability of the boundary values (proof lines 931-982).
